title: ScanScope Spine + Path/Identity (Spec A · Plan 1 of 3) Implementation Plan
summary: TDD implementation plan defining ScanScope dataclass, kb/scan-scope.json persistence, scope-aware repo_slug, context discovery, and repo-root-relative citation contract.
notes: An implementation plan, not a classic API spec, but it defines concrete technical contracts (ScanScope schema, function signatures, JSON persistence format, path-base invariant) that the system must honor -> SPEC over DOC. No ADR status/decision structure, no PRD user stories. Output filename omits the 8-char SHA-256 path hash (no shell available to compute it); date-prefixed slug is collision-safe.
